notes.title: GHOUL HAS BEEN RELEASED!
notes.content: Here we are! GHOUL has been released. We hope you like it, enjoy!

notes.title: Press Key
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are waiting for steam's approve. The game will be extactly released on this month. Thanks for everyone who wants to applicant for Press Key. In 12-13 May PDT, we will send the press keys. Don't forget to check your e-mails. GHOUL is ready. We are so excited

Thank you for your support

notes.title: Release Date Announce
notes.content:
Steam gave us a date for releasing the game for localization issues. Unfortunately it is May 12. We are excited to meet you in hotel as you are!

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: GHOUL Release Date Announce
notes.content:
[h1] GHOUL Release Date Announce[/h1]

We are happy to announce GHOUL release date! GHOUL will be released for the PC platform on 1st of May.

https://youtu.be/nfcrgG99KPU

[h1] GHOUL Çıkış Tarihi Duyurusu[/h1]

GHOUL'un 1 Mayıs'ta PC'de dijital olarak yayınlanacağını duyurmaktan mutluluk duyuyoruz.

https://youtu.be/nfcrgG99KPU
